details:
Within the last few weeks, upon entering SaccFlight planes in Test Pilots, Cold War Airbase, and other flying worlds both recently updated and not updated since 2025, vehicles will autorotate, flip, slowly lift off the ground and jump backwards without any input to the controls. If they can be flown past that without exploding, they will jerk around and flip in air, and eventually will crash against a nonexistent surface, making the surface collision noise. In vehicles with control readouts, inputs seem incredibly variable even when the controls are not being actuated. After testing, I realized that the only factor that actually made any difference was the Ghost Companion. I assume that the collider for its grab state is colliding with the plane's hull.

Reloading the world, VRChat, clearing cache, and rebooting my headset did not solve the issue, and my computer itself has been restarted multiple times. This was tested across a number of avatars, across multiple average default and in-game set heights, both with avatars lacking gogo-loco and other controller takeover add ons and with them. It is absolutely, 100% the ghost that is doing it, in both Public and Open Beta. I do not know if this is solvable on the VRC side but I thought you should know.
title: Ghost Companion Breaks SaccFlight
